title: The use of mineralized bone allograft as a single grafting material in maxillary sinus lifting with severely atrophied alveolar ridge (1-3 mm) and immediately inserted dental implants. A 3- up to 8-year retrospective study
authors: Tilaveridis I, Lazaridou M, Zouloumis L, Dimitrakopoulos I, Tilaveridis V, Tilaveridou S. Oral Maxillofac Surg. 2018 Sep;22(3):267-273.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss maxgraft granules (processed human allograft) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Maxillary sinus lift in severely absorbed alveolar ridges with simult aneous implant placement could be safely performed using mineralized allograft alone, rendering the procedure less invasive and less time-consuming” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
